title: ProductScalability
description: TOGAF-sourced quality archetype — Scalability viability dimension. Defines the property vocabulary for scalability governance: capacity limits, auto-scaling configuration, scaling thresholds. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms and as data type for Effectors/Receptors carrying scalability state. Source framework: TOGAF (Technology Architecture capacity planning) + ISO/IEC 25010 (Performance Efficiency — Capacity).

maxConcurrentUsers.description: Maximum number of concurrent users or connections the component must support.

autoScalingEnabled.description: Whether automatic horizontal scaling is enabled.

minInstances.description: Minimum number of running instances (scaling floor).

scaleUpThresholdPercent.description: Resource utilization percentage that triggers scale-up (e.g., 80).

scaleDownThresholdPercent.description: Resource utilization percentage that triggers scale-down (e.g., 30).
